# Cheatsheet

Die wichtigsten Tasten und Befehle auf einen Blick. Alles hier wird aus den
Konfigurationen erzeugt; die **vollständigen** Referenzen stehen in den Handbüchern
der Komponenten. `Super` ist die Windows-Taste.

:::{tip}
In tmux öffnet {kbd}`Strg+b` dann {kbd}`H` den durchsuchbaren Key Explorer, in Neovim
{kbd}`Space` (Leader) nach kurzer Pause which-key.
:::

::::{tab-set}

:::{tab-item} Desktop

| Taste | Aktion |

| {kbd}`Super + Enter` | Terminal öffnen |
| {kbd}`Super + Q` | Terminal öffnen |
| {kbd}`Super + Shift + Enter` | Terminal mit tmux-Sitzung `main` |
| {kbd}`Super + Leertaste` | Anwendungsstarter (Fuzzel) |
| {kbd}`Alt + Leertaste` | Anwendungsstarter (Fuzzel) |
| {kbd}`Super + D` | Anwendungsstarter (Fuzzel) |
| {kbd}`Super + R` | Anwendungsstarter (Fuzzel) |

| {kbd}`Super + B` | Browser öffnen |
| {kbd}`Super + E` | Dateimanager (PCManFM) |

:::{tab-item} tmux

`prefix` ist {kbd}`Strg+b`.

| Taste | Aktion |
| --- | --- |
| {kbd}`prefix ?` | List key bindings |
| {kbd}`prefix H` | Open the Key Explorer |
| {kbd}`prefix R` | Reload the tmux config |
| {kbd}`prefix :` | Prompt for a command |
| {kbd}`prefix G` | Toggle a floating scratch terminal |
| {kbd}`prefix b` | Toggle the status bar |
| {kbd}`prefix C-k` | Clear the screen and the scrollback |
| {kbd}`prefix s` | Choose a session from a list |
| {kbd}`prefix d` | Detach the current client |
| {kbd}`prefix $` | Rename current session |
| {kbd}`prefix (` | Switch to previous client |
| {kbd}`prefix )` | Switch to next client |
| {kbd}`prefix c` | New window in the current directory |
| {kbd}`prefix n` | Select the next window |
| {kbd}`prefix p` | Select the previous window |
| {kbd}`prefix B` | Jump to the last used window |
| {kbd}`prefix ,` | Rename current window |
| {kbd}`prefix &` | Kill current window |
| {kbd}`prefix w` | Choose a window from a list |
| {kbd}`prefix C-h` | Previous window |
| {kbd}`prefix C-l` | Next window |
| {kbd}`M-1` | Go to window 1 |
| {kbd}`prefix |` | Split side by side |
| {kbd}`prefix _` | Split stacked |
| {kbd}`prefix h` | Select the pane to the left |
| {kbd}`prefix j` | Select the pane below |
| {kbd}`prefix k` | Select the pane above |
| {kbd}`prefix l` | Select the pane to the right |
| {kbd}`prefix z` | Zoom the active pane |
| {kbd}`prefix x` | Kill the active pane |
| {kbd}`prefix !` | Break the pane into a new window |
| {kbd}`prefix M-h` | Resize the pane left |
| {kbd}`prefix M-l` | Resize the pane right |
| {kbd}`prefix ;` | Move to the previously active pane |
| {kbd}`prefix o` | Select the next pane |
| {kbd}`prefix Space` | Select next layout |
| {kbd}`prefix M-1` | Set the even-horizontal layout |
| {kbd}`prefix M-5` | Select the tiled layout |
| {kbd}`prefix [` | Enter copy mode |
| {kbd}`prefix C-f` | Search the scrollback |
| {kbd}`v` | Rectangle toggle |
| {kbd}`C-v` | Rectangle toggle |
| {kbd}`y` | Copy the selection and leave copy mode |
| {kbd}`q` | Cancel |
| {kbd}`prefix ]` | Paste the most recent paste buffer |
| {kbd}`prefix =` | Choose a paste buffer from a list |
| {kbd}`prefix #` | List all paste buffers |
| {kbd}`prefix -` | Delete the most recent paste buffer |

Vollständig und durchsuchbar: [tmux-Tastenkombinationen](https://aco-tmux.readthedocs.io/en/latest/keybindings/quick/).
:::

:::{tab-item} Neovim

`<leader>` ist {kbd}`Space`.

| Taste | Aktion |
| --- | --- |
| {kbd}`<leader><space>` | Find files |
| {kbd}`<leader>ff` | Find files |
| {kbd}`<leader>fg` | Live grep |
| {kbd}`<leader>fb` | Find buffers |
| {kbd}`<leader>/` | Search in current buffer |
| {kbd}`<leader>e` | Toggle file explorer (nvim-tree) |
| {kbd}`-` | Open parent directory (Oil) |
| {kbd}`<C-s>` | Save file |
| {kbd}`gd` | Go to definition |
| {kbd}`<S-h>` | Previous buffer |
| {kbd}`<S-l>` | Next buffer |
| {kbd}`<leader>bd` | Delete buffer |
| {kbd}`[d` | Previous diagnostic |
| {kbd}`]d` | Next diagnostic |
| {kbd}`<leader>xx` | Diagnostics list, all buffers (Trouble) |
| {kbd}`<leader>db` | Toggle breakpoint |
| {kbd}`<leader>dc` | Start / Continue |
| {kbd}`<leader>gd` | Git diff against index (split) |

Alle Belegungen und Befehle: [Neovim-Handbuch](https://aco-nvim.readthedocs.io/en/latest/).
:::

:::{tab-item} Vim

Vim verwendet dieselben Leader-Belegungen wie Neovim (`<Space>`), siehe
[Vim-Tastenkombinationen](https://aco-vim.readthedocs.io/en/latest/keybindings/).
:::

:::{tab-item} Shell & Befehle

| Befehl | Wirkung |
| --- | --- |
| `aco update` | System aktualisieren (`pacman -Syu`) und Defaults zusammenführen |
| `aco status` | Zeigt, ob die Konfiguration aktiv ist |
| `aco list` | Installierte ACO-Pakete |
| `aco install [modul]` | Installierte Module aktivieren (ohne `sudo`) |
| `aco deactivate [modul]` | Vorherige Einstellungen wiederherstellen |
| `aco path` | Verzeichnis deiner bearbeitbaren Kopien |
| `y` | Yazi starten und danach im besuchten Verzeichnis bleiben |
| `j <teil>` | Per zoxide in ein häufig besuchtes Verzeichnis springen |
| `tm` | tmux-Sitzung `main` öffnen oder anhängen |
| `nv` / `v` | Neovim / Vim |
| `wp` | wallpaper-Befehl |
| `dotfiles` | In deine bearbeitbaren Konfigurationskopien wechseln |

Alle Befehle: [`aco`-Referenz](commands.md).
:::
